[size=4][b]Description
[/b][/size]
Tired of navigating through the standard Options tab and scrolling down just to tweak your mod settings? GMCM Shortcut adds a global hotkey to instantly open (and close) the Generic Mod Config Menu.

[list]
[*]Instant Access: Opens the config menu immediately from the Title Screen or while In-Game.
[/list][list]
[*]Toggle Functionality: Press the key once to open the menu, press it again to close it and resume play.
[/list][list]
[*]Safe Check: Prevents opening during cutscenes or when the player isn't free to act.
[/list]

[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/40981/40981-1767834884-1072516021.gif[/img]﻿[/center]

[line]
[size=4][b]Requirements
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Required for this mod to function)
[/list]
[line]
[center]﻿[/center]
[size=4][b]Configuration
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]By default, the hotkey is set to [b]F8[/b].
[*]You can change this keybinding to anything you like (e.g., F10, P, Backspace) directly inside the game:
[*]Open GMCM (press [b]F8[/b] or go via the Options tab).
[*]Select GMCM Shortcut from the mod list.
[*]Change the Open Menu Shortcut to your preferred key.
[*]Save & Close.
[/list][line]

[*]Extract the [font=Courier New]GMCMShortcut[/font] folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.
[*]Run the game!
[/list][line]
